div.head: II Cn 60
div.ab: Gif man æt unlagum man bewæpnige, forgilde hine be halsfange; ⁊ gif hine man gebinde, forgilde be healfan were.
Be ðam þæt man oðerne bewepnað. Gyf man æt unlagum man bewepnie, forgylde hine be his healsfange; ⁊ gyf man hine gebinde, forgildon hine be healfan were.
Gif man æt unlagum man bewæpnige, forgilde hine be halsfange; ⁊ gif hine man gebinde, forgilde be healfan wære.
Qui aliquem exarmabit iniuste, soluat eum secundum suum hálsfang; si ligabit, dimidia wéra reddat eum.
. . . Si quis exarmauerit hominem contra iusticiam, X sol. ei emendet; et si ligatus fuerit, medietas pretii eius, quod Angli dicunt be healue þere, ei persoluatur.
[60] Si quis iniuste quemquam dearmauerit, soluat illi collicipium; si autem ligauerit, soluat illi dimidium redempcionis eius (id est: IIII l.).
Be ðam þæt man oðerne bewepnað. Gyf man æt unlagum man bewepnie, forgylde hine be his healsfange, ⁊ gyf man hine gebinde, forgildon hine be healfan were.
Gif man æt unlagum man bewæpnige, forgilde hine be halsfange; and gif hine man gebinde, forgilde be healfan were.
(Davon, dass man einen anderen entwaffnet. B) Wenn jemand zu Unrecht einen Mann entwaffnet, bezahle er ihn mit dessen Halsfang; und wenn jemand ihn bindet, bezahle er mit [dessen] halbem Wergelde.
(Of disarming another man. B) If anyone wrongfully disarms a man, let him pay for him with his healsfang; and if anyone binds him, let him pay with half [his] wergild.

Concerning the case of one man disarming another. If one man unjustly disarms another, he shall compensate him by the payment of a sum equivalent to his healsfang, and if he binds him, he shall compensate him by the payment of a sum equivalent to half his wergeld.
If anyone illegally disarms a man, he is to compensate him with healsfang; and if he binds him, he is to compensate with half the wergild.
If anyone illegally seizes a man’s weapons, he is to pay him compensation equivalent to his healsfang; and if he binds him, he must compensate him with half his wergild.
